0022600121.text: The Boston Celtics (0-1, 12th in the East, 1.5 games back for fifth in the Atlantic) host the Chicago Bulls (1-1, eighth in the East, 0.5 games back for third in the Central), with Devin Carter out for Boston due to illness and Nic Claxton out for Chicago due to a hamstring injury. The teams have not yet met in the 2026-27 season, and Boston won the 2025-26 season series 2-1. Their most recent meeting was on February 11, 2026, in Boston, where the Celtics won 124-105.
